GUIDES FOR REAL FINANCE WORK

Understand the workflow before you review the result

Choose a guide by the task in front of you. Start with bank reconciliation to trace statement activity against the books, or use the 13-week cash flow forecast guide to follow expected receipts and payments. Before a supplier payment, see how three-way match compares the order, receipt, and invoice.

Each published workflow has a plain-language overview and a step-by-step guide with worked examples and cited sources. The overview explains which records the skill compares and what exceptions it can flag. The detailed guide separates outside facts from the skill’s own rules so you can check the reasoning. Examples use made-up figures; these pages explain the skills and do not connect to or reconcile your company data.
